description: This file defines the AuthSession class, which manages authentication tokens, token refresh flow, and session state for a Flutter application. It handles saving tokens from API responses, retrieving access tokens, clearing sessions, and refreshing tokens using external AuthApi and TokenStorage classes.

classes.name: AuthSession
classes.description: Class managing authentication token lifecycle, including storage, refresh, and retrieval operations.

methods.name: saveTokensFromResponse
methods.description: Saves access and refresh tokens extracted from a JSON response.

methods.name: getAccessToken
methods.description: Retrieves the current access token from storage.

methods.name: clearSession
methods.description: Clears the current session tokens from storage.

methods.name: refreshAccessToken
methods.description: Initiates a token refresh, ensuring only one refresh occurs concurrently.
